The '''improved energy cell''' was a modification made to [[Pistol/Legends|pistols]], [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]] and heavy weapons that required a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] to operate. Unlike [[enhanced energy cell]] used in [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], the improved energy cell accessory increased the efficiency of the energy flow between a power pack and the weapon's firing mechanism. A weapon with the improved energy cell modification could make twice as many shots it could fire on a single power pack.
